title: Gb3 encodes a unique kinase fusion protein conferring greenbug resistance in wheat.
journal: Nature Genetics (PMID 42778722; paywalled, no PMCID, published 2026-09-23)

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Europe PMC flags: not open access, no supplement, no database cross-references, no text-mined accessions. NCBI elink from PubMed returned only PubMed-to-PubMed links (no GEO, SRA or BioProject). A Zenodo search on the DOI returned 0 records. An NCBI BioProject keyword search found PRJNA1329330, titled exactly as the paper and registered 2025-09-16, with data type 'Raw sequence reads'. It also found an unrelated 2013 greenbug transcriptome project, PRJNA196845.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything about the biology comes from the abstract alone: Gb3 cloning, its kinase-pseudokinase MAP3K-like domain, origin by fusion and duplication in the Triticeae (the wheat tribe), transgenic and knockout validation in Fielder and TAM112 wheat, and the oxylipin and metabolite findings. The data availability statement, sample counts and any processed tables could not be read because the full text is paywalled.

a1_downloadable.note: The only deposit found, BioProject PRJNA1329330, holds raw sequence reads, which the project rules forbid downloading. No processed table was found on NCBI, Zenodo or Europe PMC. Checked in repository metadata.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No labelled table exists. This is a single-gene cloning paper, so any label (resistant vs susceptible, aphid feeding outcome) would have to be built from raw reads or from paywalled figures. Inferred from metadata plus abstract.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs exist only as raw reads (sequencing, likely RNA-seq or genome data) in the BioProject. There is no feature table. Seen in BioProject metadata.

a4_units_stated.note: Not checked. No tabular data was found.

a5_enough_rows.note: The study is about one gene, a few wheat lines and a few greenbug biotypes (insect strains). Labelled units would be a handful of genotypes, far below 400. Row count not seen; this judgement rests on the abstract.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Not assessed. Raw wheat sequencing would far exceed 5 GB.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Not checked. Paper counts are not visible (paywalled) and no files were opened.

a8_label_provenance.note: Not applicable. There is no label column. Phenotypes in the paper come from aphid bioassays, which are real measurements, but they are not deposited as a table.

c2_audit.note: Not searched, because the evaluation stopped at Part A. The empty list does not mean no models exist.

backbone.name: ESM-2, a protein language model (could in principle embed resistance proteins, but the data is a single gene)

integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Not assessed: stopped at Part A.

honest_claim_h3: Not assessed: stopped at Part A. No ML claim is possible from a single cloned gene with raw-read deposits only.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use wheat gene sequences or expression to predict whether a plant resists greenbug aphids.
plain_idea.train_on: Would need many wheat or Aegilops (wild grass) lines, each with sequence or expression data. Only raw reads for an unknown, likely small, number of samples were found.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a line resists or is susceptible to greenbug, measured in aphid feeding bioassays. These phenotypes were not deposited as a table.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Wheat breeders screening for aphid resistance could prioritize lines, but with one cloned gene a lookup for Gb3 presence would do the job without ML.

ml_idea: None viable. A gene-cloning study with raw-read deposits and a handful of genotypes cannot support a learned model. Checking for Gb3 presence or absence is a lookup, not ML.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated, because Part A failed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Already failed: the PRJNA1329330 BioProject metadata says 'Raw sequence reads' only, and no processed table appears on NCBI, Zenodo or Europe PMC.

verdict_reason: This is a paywalled single-gene cloning paper. Its only deposit (BioProject PRJNA1329330) is raw sequence reads, with no labelled table and at most a handful of genotypes. That fails A1/A3 (only raw data), A2 (the label would have to be built) and A5 (far too few examples).
